description: Config-driven mapping from detected object classes to astronaut-hazard metadata. Class names are DATA, never hardcoded: a future trained model that outputs these classes maps straight into this table without code changes. A detected class missing from this table is reported as UNCLASSIFIED and never claimed to be hazardous.

microgravity.note: Objects do not settle; an unsecured object keeps travelling until it hits something, so free-floating-object hazards are elevated in this operational environment. The mode is operational CONFIGURATION (ENVIRONMENT_MODE) — the AI does not infer gravity from pixels.

planetary.note: Gravity settles most objects; unsecured objects still matter but are a lesser free-floating hazard.

person.reason: The astronaut is always tracked; the person class itself is not a hazard. Proximity and immobility of this detection feed the astronaut status and emergency candidate logic.

experiment_box.reason: Stowed/parked equipment. Legacy experiment class from the box-handling demo retained in the knowledge base.

red_box.reason: Handled object (legacy demo class). Benign when secured; handled-object logic could attach later.

yellow_box.reason: Handled object (legacy demo class). Benign when secured; handled-object logic could attach later.

target_area.reason: Stationary fixture / destination zone (legacy demo class).

floating_tool.reason: Unsecured object may collide with astronaut or equipment in microgravity

unsecured_object.reason: Unrestrained object is a collision/motion hazard in microgravity

sharp_object.recommended_action: Do not approach directly; secure object
sharp_object.reason: Sharp or pointed object floating in the cabin; puncture hazard for crew and suits

loose_cable.reason: Loose cable can drift, snag or become an entanglement hazard in microgravity

debris.reason: Free-floating fragments are a projectile risk for crew and equipment

liquid_fluid.recommended_action: Isolate the leak and contain the fluid
liquid_fluid.reason: Free-floating fluid beads can enter equipment or electronics in microgravity

smoke.recommended_action: Confirm fire/smoke indication and evacuate module
smoke.reason: Smoke indication is a fire precursor and a crew-health hazard; escalate promptly

fire.recommended_action: Activate fire response and evacuate module
fire.reason: Fire indication is immediately life-threatening in a pressurized module

damaged_equipment.recommended_action: Isolate the equipment and report for inspection
damaged_equipment.reason: Damaged equipment may shed debris or fail explosively under load

obstacle.reason: Unexpected object blocking a walkway, hatch or equipment access

bottle.reason: COCO class mapped for the SIH demo: a loose container can drift and become a collision hazard in microgravity

cup.reason: COCO class mapped for the SIH demo: a loose cup drifts and may release contents in microgravity

cell phone.recommended_action: Stow or restraint the handheld device
cell phone.reason: COCO class mapped for the SIH demo: an unsecured handheld device is a free-floating-object hazard in microgravity

book.reason: COCO class mapped for the SIH demo: an unsecured book can drift and strike crew or equipment

sports ball.reason: COCO class mapped for the SIH demo: a loose ball is a visible free-floating-object demonstration prop

fork.reason: COCO class mapped for the SIH demo: a floating utensil with tines is a point-contact hazard

knife.recommended_action: Do not approach directly; secure the knife
knife.reason: COCO class mapped for the SIH demo: a sharp bladed object floating in the cabin is a puncture hazard

scissors.recommended_action: Do not approach directly; secure the scissors
scissors.reason: COCO class mapped for the SIH demo: a sharp pointed object floating in the cabin is a puncture hazard

pen.recommended_action: Stow or restraint the writing instrument
pen.reason: Custom SIH class mapped from classes.json: a small unsecured object drifts and can jam or strike equipment in microgravity
